name: SalesBlink
description_en:
SalesBlink combines cold-email sequences, mailbox connection, warmup, verification and reply management. Its current site also provides MCP, a skill, CLI and REST API as agent-facing surfaces. These are different control interfaces for an outreach account, not evidence of an open-source server. Done-for-you outreach and campaign setup are separate services.

A pilot could connect one mailbox, upload an approved list, validate addresses and let the AI draft a short sequence. Review field substitutions and the outbox before launch, then work responses in the unified inbox. The pricing page documents evergreen enrollment for new list members and follow-ups until a prospect replies; test those rules before repeatedly adding records. If delivery stalls, check authentication, address status and already-sent messages before rerunning.
description_zh:
SalesBlink 组合冷邮件序列、邮箱连接、预热、验证与回复管理。当前官网还提供 MCP、skill、CLI 与 REST API 等智能体接口。这些是同一触达账户的不同控制方式，不证明存在开源服务器。代运营触达与活动设置属于其他服务。

试点可连接一个邮箱，上传经授权名单，验证地址，再由 AI 起草简短序列。启动前核对字段替换与发件队列，然后在统一收件箱处理回复。定价页描述新列表成员自动入序，以及对方回复前的跟进；重复加入记录前应先验证这些规则。发送停滞时，先检查认证、地址状态与已发消息，再重跑。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage follow-ups, sender connections and a unified reply inbox.
core_features.explanation_zh: 管理跟进、发送端连接与统一回复箱。

core_features.explanation_en: MCP and plan-dependent API/CLI expose outreach controls.
core_features.explanation_zh: MCP 与按套餐提供的 API/CLI 暴露触达控制。

The pricing page documents evergreen enrollment for new list members and follow-ups until a prospect replies; test those rules before repeatedly adding records. If delivery stalls, check authentication, address status and already-sent messages before rerunning.

items.en: SalesBlink fits a team coordinating personalized email follow-up, including technical teams wanting an agent interface. Warmup and provider matching are tools to evaluate, not guarantees of inbox placement. Confirm the plan’s API permissions and action costs before automating changes from an assistant. This research did not execute MCP, the CLI or a mailbox connection; rate limits, duplicate handling and error recovery remain acceptance tasks. Source licensing and self-hosting were not verified.
items.zh: SalesBlink 适合协调个性化邮件跟进的团队，也适合需要智能体接口的技术团队。预热和供应商匹配是待评估工具，不保证进入收件箱。让助手自动修改前，应确认套餐 API 权限与动作成本。本次未运行 MCP、CLI 或邮箱连接；限流、去重与错误恢复仍需验收，源代码许可及自托管也未核实。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The pricing view shows annual equivalents of Starter $25/month, Growth $79 and Business $179, alongside monthly figures of $29, $99 and $199. Starter includes 10,000 emails/month and 1,000 AI credits; Growth lists unlimited emails and 5,000 AI credits; Business 20,000 credits. A fourteen-day no-card trial is documented. Unlimited connected accounts does not mean mailboxes or domains are supplied at no cost. MCP is advertised across plans; API, skill and CLI are explicitly listed in Growth’s card.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 定价视图展示年付折算 Starter 每月 25 美元、Growth 79、Business 179，旁列月付 29、99、199。Starter 含每月 10,000 封与 1,000 AI 额度；Growth 邮件无限、5,000 AI 额度；Business 为 20,000 额度。页面提供十四天免卡试用。连接账户无限不代表免费提供邮箱或域名。MCP 宣传跨套餐可用；API、skill 与 CLI 明确列在 Growth 卡片中。
